% A guard: cases the fix of KOMA-Script's footnotes must not break. In
% article with Times, a footnote's text starts at its mark, and each
% footnote keeps the words and spaces of the PDF: a narrow first word
% with a space after it, and one with none.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{times}
\begin{document}
Text one.\footnote{I thank a reader.}
Text two.\footnote{I'd say so.}
\end{document}
